title: Scheduler view — all scheduled tasks, status & problems
notes: A live view of every scheduled task/routine and its status. Refreshed audit (2026-09-22): 3 tasks show up at the cloud/account level — Weekly Database Email Draft (healthy, cloud), Daily Morning Brief (healthy, cloud), and OLD Weekender Automation (Mac Mini) (disabled, stale since 9/17, superseded — see below). IMPORTANT BLIND SPOT confirmed this round: the Oasis Mini runs its own local "Routines" (Home Anniversary Outreach, Weekender — both confirmed 9/22) that live only in that machine's own Claude app and never show up in this cloud list at all, and aren't visible to Claude even when a session is linked to that machine — only Scott/Orit can see that list directly in the app's own Settings/Routines panel. So this cloud count always understates what's actually running on the Mini. A live version would need either a way for the dashboard's Vercel backend to read scheduled-task/Routine status directly (which it can't do today) or the Mini's Routines themselves posting a heartbeat, the way the machine-status panel already expects — for now this list is refreshed by hand from what Scott/Orit report seeing in the app.

title: MLS Activity Sync
notes: Discovered via audit (9/22): a local Routine on Scott's MacBook Pro, Mondays ~10am. Checks ARMLS/Flexmls "Activity Report" emails and logs a short MLS Activity entry per listing in Oasis Navigator. Confirmed healthy — ran successfully yesterday (9/21), added 2 entries for the 4007 E. Agave Rd, Phoenix transaction. Good candidate to move to the Mini for the same reason as the others: local routines only run while the Pro itself is awake and online, so this silently gets skipped if Scott is traveling with it on a Monday. Unlike the browser-only automations, this one depends on an actual local checkout of the oasis-navigator codebase (it ran npm ci and generated a Prisma client mid-run) — moving it means setting up that project on the Mini too, not just recreating the routine text.
